What’s new

MindMap AI is now xDraft by xDev: one studio for mind maps, flowcharts and software architecture.

  • Five kinds of diagram: Mind Map, Flowchart, Architecture, C4 and Deployment views, and Sequence. Start from a template, or convert a map into a flowchart or an architecture diagram.
  • A new look on Mac, iPad and iPhone: Home, the library, the editor, Settings and the sheets are redesigned.
  • Context menus on the canvas and on what you select: right-click on the Mac, or touch and hold on iPad.
  • Check Diagram finds open ends, such as a decision with one branch or a step that leads nowhere, and offers fixes you apply in one undo step.
  • Architecture Document: a twelve-section document built from your architecture model, exported as PDF or Markdown, plus a Design Review Deck.
  • Sketch to Diagram on iPad: draw boxes, diamonds and arrows with Apple Pencil, check what xDraft read, and keep it as a flowchart you can edit.
  • AI on your device with Apple Intelligence: Ask xDraft, one command bar for AI actions that also translates topics into English, Vietnamese or Japanese; Draw from a Folder on the Mac; and suggestions inside diagrams. Nothing is sent to xDev.
  • xDraft Pro adds Architecture with its C4, Deployment and Sequence views, the Architecture Document and Design Review Deck, conversions, high-resolution and multi-page export, more themes, voice input and advanced AI. It is now also available as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan; Lifetime stays a one-time purchase. Mind maps, flowcharts and Check Diagram stay free.

Features

Six ways to draw an idea, one place to keep it.

Pick the diagram that fits the question. Every change can be undone, and AI only ever suggests.

01

Mind maps

Topics lay themselves out on an infinite canvas, or switch to the outline to write and reorder quickly. Everything from MindMap AI is still here.

02

Flowcharts

Start, process, decision and end steps with Yes and No branches; Play a Path walks it step by step. Start from a template, or turn a map into a flowchart or architecture diagram.

03

Architecture, C4, Deployment and Sequence (Pro)

Architecture: systems, services, data stores, queues and actors, with their relationships. C4 and Deployment: the same model as C4 Context, Container and Component views, and per environment. Sequence: messages between the parts of your architecture, row by row.

04

Check and document

Check Diagram finds gaps, such as a decision with one branch or a dead-end step, and offers fixes you undo in one step. Architecture Document (Pro): twelve sections with figures and tables from your architecture model, as PDF or Markdown, plus a Design Review Deck.

05

Sketch on iPad

Sketch to Diagram: draw boxes, diamonds, arrows and words with Apple Pencil, and get a flowchart you can edit before you keep it. Recognized on your iPad, nothing is sent anywhere.

06

AI on your device, with Apple Intelligence

Ask xDraft: one command bar for AI on the selection or the whole map, including translation into English, Vietnamese or Japanese. Generate a map from a short description, or on the Mac from the file names in a folder you choose (never their contents). AI results are labeled suggestions you edit, accept or discard, and undo in one step.

07

Import, export and share

Import Markdown, text, OPML and other mind map files; export Markdown, text, PNG, PDF and backups. Share Link: someone without the app opens the map in the App Clip. iCloud sync; the Apple Watch app adds ideas to your Inbox map. Shortcuts and Spotlight.

08

Made for the Mac

A full menu bar with a shortcut for every command; each map in its own window. AI Apps: let AI apps on your Mac read your maps over MCP. Off by default and local to this Mac; topics an app proposes wait for your Accept.

Privacy

Data Not Collected

xDraft has no account, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. xDev runs no servers for it, and your maps are never sent to xDev.

Read the privacy policy→
  • AI runs on your device with Apple Intelligence.
  • Your maps are stored on your device.
  • AI apps you connect on a Mac can read your maps only after you turn it on.

Platforms

Made for the Mac first.

Mac

Coming soon to the Mac App Store

Built for the Mac first, with every command in the menu bar, keyboard shortcuts and multiple windows. Requires macOS 26 or later. AI features need a Mac with Apple silicon and Apple Intelligence.

iPhone and iPad

Coming soon to the App Store

A touch-friendly canvas and outline, the Share Extension for text and links, and Shortcuts actions. On iPad, sketch a flowchart with Apple Pencil and edit what xDraft reads. Share Link: someone without the app opens the map in the App Clip; the Apple Watch app adds ideas to your Inbox map. Requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. Every plan also unlocks Pro on the Mac.

xDraft is available in English, Vietnamese and Japanese.
